easy: Going all the way around something.

ex.en: The surrounding hills made the town look like a bowl.
ex.ko: 주위를 둘러싼 언덕 때문에 마을이 그릇처럼 보였다.

easy: Matching or fitting well with something else.

ex.en: Her story is consistent with what her brother said.
ex.ko: 그녀의 이야기는 오빠가 한 말과 일치한다.

easy: Giving the same result every time.

ex.en: Our science test gave consistent results every time.
ex.ko: 우리 과학 실험은 매번 일관된 결과가 나왔다.

easy: Going on without stopping.

ex.en: The continuing rain kept us inside all weekend.
ex.ko: 계속되는 비 때문에 우리는 주말 내내 집에 있었다.

easy: Lasting for a long time.

ex.en: My continuing headache lasted all week.
ex.ko: 두통이 일주일 내내 계속되었다.

easy: To get money for doing work.

ex.en: My dad earns money by driving a bus.
ex.ko: 아빠는 버스를 운전해서 돈을 번다.

easy: To get something good because of what you did.

ex.en: She earned a gold star by reading ten books.
ex.ko: 그녀는 책 열 권을 읽어서 금색 별 스티커를 받았다.

easy: To touch or hold something with your fingers.

ex.en: He fingered the soft fur of the puppy.
ex.ko: 그는 강아지의 부드러운 털을 손가락으로 만졌다.

easy: To touch something to find out how it feels.

ex.en: I fingered the cloth to see if it was soft.
ex.ko: 나는 천이 부드러운지 손가락으로 만져 보았다.

easy: The color between black and white, like a rain cloud.

ex.en: The grey elephant sprayed water with its trunk.
ex.ko: 회색 코끼리가 코로 물을 뿌렸다.

easy: Having white or silver hair because of being old.

ex.en: My grandfather has grey hair and a big smile.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 머리가 희끗희끗하고 환하게 웃으신다.

easy: A musical instrument with strings that you play with your fingers or a pick.

ex.en: My sister plays the guitar in the school band.
ex.ko: 누나는 학교 밴드에서 기타를 친다.

easy: The food you eat at one time, like breakfast or dinner.

ex.en: Dinner is my favorite meal of the day.
ex.ko: 저녁은 하루 중 내가 제일 좋아하는 식사다.

easy: One of the times each day when you eat, like breakfast or lunch.

ex.en: Breakfast is the first meal of the day.
ex.ko: 아침은 하루의 첫 끼니다.

easy: Of course; just as you would expect.

ex.en: Naturally, my dog ran to the door when I got home.
ex.ko: 당연히 내가 집에 오자 우리 개가 문으로 달려왔다.

easy: In a way that comes from nature, with no help from people.

ex.en: These flowers grew naturally by the river.
ex.ko: 이 꽃들은 강가에서 저절로 자랐다.

easy: Because that is how someone is from birth.

ex.en: My cat is naturally shy around strangers.
ex.ko: 우리 고양이는 낯선 사람 앞에서 천성적으로 수줍음을 탄다.

easy: In a way that cannot be any other way.

ex.en: If you jump in the pool, you will necessarily get wet.
ex.ko: 수영장에 뛰어들면 반드시 젖는다.

easy: Two or more people or groups working together to reach a goal.

ex.en: Our class has a partnership with a school in Korea.
ex.ko: 우리 반은 한국의 한 학교와 협력 관계를 맺고 있다.

easy: A small bag sewn into clothes for holding little things.

ex.en: I put the coin in my pocket.
ex.ko: 나는 동전을 주머니에 넣었다.

easy: Useful in real life, not just a nice idea.

ex.en: Rain boots are practical shoes for a muddy day.
ex.ko: 장화는 진흙투성이인 날에 실용적인 신발이다.

easy: Thinking about what really works instead of dreaming.

ex.en: Mom is practical, so she packed an umbrella.
ex.ko: 엄마는 현실적이라서 우산을 챙기셨다.

easy: Mostly; most of all.

ex.en: This book is primarily about space.
ex.ko: 이 책은 주로 우주에 관한 것이다.

easy: Shown to be true for sure.

ex.en: Exercise is a proven way to stay healthy.
ex.ko: 운동은 건강을 지키는 검증된 방법이다.

easy: Even if there is a problem; not stopped by it.

ex.en: It was raining, but we played soccer regardless.
ex.ko: 비가 왔지만 우리는 그래도 축구를 했다.

easy: Judged by comparing with something else, not exact.

ex.en: After a noisy day, the library felt like relative quiet.
ex.ko: 시끄러운 하루를 보낸 뒤라서 도서관은 상대적으로 조용하게 느껴졌다.

easy: A person in your family, like an aunt or cousin.

ex.en: All my relatives came to my birthday party.
ex.ko: 모든 친척이 내 생일 파티에 왔다.

easy: To move very fast.

ex.en: I rushed to the bus stop so I would not be late.
ex.ko: 나는 늦지 않으려고 버스 정류장으로 서둘러 달려갔다.

easy: To run at someone or something suddenly.

ex.en: The big dog rushed at the squirrel.
ex.ko: 큰 개가 다람쥐에게 달려들었다.

easy: To make someone do something too fast.

ex.en: Please don't rush me while I tie my shoes.
ex.ko: 신발끈을 묶는 동안 재촉하지 마.

easy: Clear, so you can see or hear every detail.

ex.en: The camera takes sharp pictures of birds.
ex.ko: 그 카메라는 새 사진을 선명하게 찍는다.

easy: Having a thin end that can poke or cut.

ex.en: Be careful, the pencil tip is sharp.
ex.ko: 조심해, 연필 끝이 뾰족해.

easy: Quick to notice small things; smart.

ex.en: Mia has a sharp mind and spots every mistake.
ex.ko: 미아는 머리가 예리해서 모든 실수를 찾아낸다.

easy: A game where two teams kick a ball into a goal.

ex.en: We play soccer at recess every day.
ex.ko: 우리는 쉬는 시간마다 축구를 한다.

easy: Lasting only a short time.

ex.en: The bridge is temporary until the new one is built.
ex.ko: 그 다리는 새 다리가 지어질 때까지만 쓰는 임시 다리다.

easy: Something sneaky done to fool someone, often as a joke.

ex.en: My brother played a trick on me with a fake spider.
ex.ko: 형이 가짜 거미로 나에게 장난을 쳤다.

easy: The sound part of a TV show or video.

ex.en: The video has no audio, so I can't hear anything.
ex.ko: 그 영상은 소리가 안 나와서 아무것도 들을 수 없다.

easy: A recording of sound that you can play and listen to.

ex.en: Dad made an audio of me reading my story.
ex.ko: 아빠는 내가 이야기를 읽는 것을 녹음하셨다.

easy: A hard part of the body that is part of the skeleton.

ex.en: The dog buried a bone in the yard.
ex.ko: 개가 마당에 뼈다귀를 묻었다.

easy: The hard material inside your body that bones are made of.

ex.en: Milk helps build strong bone.
ex.ko: 우유는 튼튼한 뼈를 만드는 데 도움이 된다.

easy: Things you wear on your body, like shirts and pants.

ex.en: I packed warm clothing for the camping trip.
ex.ko: 나는 캠핑 여행에 따뜻한 옷을 챙겼다.

easy: Hard to understand because it has many parts.

ex.en: The rules of this board game are complicated.
ex.ko: 이 보드게임의 규칙은 복잡하다.

easy: Not sure what is going on; mixed up in your mind.

ex.en: I felt confused when the teacher changed the plan.
ex.ko: 선생님이 계획을 바꾸셔서 나는 어리둥절했다.

easy: Mixed up and not in a clear order.

ex.en: His story was confused, so nobody understood it.
ex.ko: 그의 이야기는 뒤죽박죽이어서 아무도 이해하지 못했다.

easy: To speak up for someone or something.

ex.en: Sam defended his friend when others teased him.
ex.ko: 샘은 다른 아이들이 놀릴 때 친구를 감싸 주었다.

easy: To try to stop the other side from scoring or winning.

ex.en: Our team has to defend when the other team has the ball.
ex.ko: 상대 팀이 공을 가지고 있을 때 우리 팀은 수비해야 한다.

easy: To keep someone or something safe from harm.

ex.en: The goalie defends the net.
ex.ko: 골키퍼는 골대를 지킨다.

easy: Cut or split into pieces.

ex.en: The pizza was divided into eight slices.
ex.ko: 피자는 여덟 조각으로 나뉘었다.

easy: Having a strip in the middle that keeps cars going opposite ways apart.

ex.en: We drove on a divided highway to the beach.
ex.ko: 우리는 중앙분리대가 있는 고속도로를 타고 바닷가에 갔다.

easy: Normal and ordinary, happening all the time.

ex.en: Brushing teeth is an everyday job.
ex.ko: 양치질은 매일 하는 일이다.

easy: Ordinary, nothing special.

ex.en: Seeing squirrels is an everyday event in our yard.
ex.ko: 다람쥐를 보는 것은 우리 마당에서 흔한 일이다.

easy: How much or how far something goes.

ex.en: We saw the extent of the flood after the storm.
ex.ko: 폭풍이 지나간 뒤 우리는 홍수의 피해 정도를 보았다.

easy: How big or how far something stretches.

ex.en: We could not see the whole extent of the lake.
ex.ko: 우리는 호수의 전체 넓이를 볼 수 없었다.

easy: Catching fish for fun.

ex.en: Fishing with Grandpa is my favorite weekend fun.
ex.ko: 할아버지와 낚시하는 것은 내가 제일 좋아하는 주말 놀이다.

easy: Catching fish as a job.

ex.en: Fishing is the main job in this small village.
ex.ko: 어업은 이 작은 마을의 주된 일이다.

easy: To get a computer disk ready to hold files.

ex.en: Dad had to format the old USB drive.
ex.ko: 아빠는 오래된 USB를 포맷해야 했다.

easy: A small, thin opening between two things.

ex.en: The cat squeezed through a gap in the fence.
ex.ko: 고양이가 울타리 틈으로 비집고 들어갔다.

easy: A door in a fence or wall that opens and closes.

ex.en: Please close the gate so the dog can't get out.
ex.ko: 개가 나가지 못하게 대문을 닫아 주세요.

easy: Help from doctors and nurses to keep people healthy.

ex.en: Doctors and nurses give healthcare to people in the town.
ex.ko: 의사와 간호사는 마을 사람들에게 의료 서비스를 제공한다.

easy: Making you say "wow" because it is so great.

ex.en: The fireworks show was impressive.
ex.ko: 불꽃놀이는 정말 인상적이었다.

easy: Bringing two things together so they touch.

ex.en: The joining of the two train cars made a loud click.
ex.ko: 두 기차 칸이 연결될 때 딸깍하는 큰 소리가 났다.

easy: A class or time when you learn something.

ex.en: I have a piano lesson every Tuesday.
ex.ko: 나는 매주 화요일에 피아노 레슨이 있다.

easy: What a story or event teaches you.

ex.en: The lesson of the story is to be kind.
ex.ko: 그 이야기의 교훈은 친절하라는 것이다.

easy: Showing love and caring.

ex.en: My loving grandma hugs me every time I visit.
ex.ko: 다정한 할머니는 내가 갈 때마다 안아 주신다.

easy: Being part of a club or group.

ex.en: My membership at the library lets me borrow ten books.
ex.ko: 도서관 회원증으로 나는 책을 열 권 빌릴 수 있다.

easy: To fix something onto a base or wall.

ex.en: Dad mounted the TV on the wall.
ex.ko: 아빠는 TV를 벽에 설치했다.

easy: To go up or get bigger.

ex.en: The excitement mounted as the game began.
ex.ko: 경기가 시작되자 흥분이 점점 커졌다.

easy: To glue or place something on a card or board to show it.

ex.en: She mounted her photos on colored paper.
ex.ko: 그녀는 사진을 색종이 위에 붙였다.

easy: To pop into your mind.

ex.en: It suddenly occurred to me that I forgot my lunch.
ex.ko: 도시락을 깜빡했다는 생각이 갑자기 떠올랐다.

easy: To be found or to happen.

ex.en: Rainbows occur when the sun comes out after rain.
ex.ko: 비가 온 뒤 해가 나오면 무지개가 나타난다.

easy: A place where cars can stop and stay.

ex.en: There is free parking behind the school.
ex.ko: 학교 뒤에 무료 주차장이 있다.

easy: Putting a car in a spot and leaving it there.

ex.en: Mom is good at parking in tiny spots.
ex.ko: 엄마는 좁은 자리에 주차를 잘하신다.

easy: A plan or idea that you suggest to others.

ex.en: Her proposal was to have a class picnic.
ex.ko: 그녀의 제안은 학급 소풍을 가자는 것이었다.

easy: Asking someone to marry you.

ex.en: The prince's proposal made the princess smile.
ex.ko: 왕자의 청혼에 공주는 미소를 지었다.

easy: Offering an idea for others to think about.

ex.en: Everyone listened to Ben's proposal for a new game.
ex.ko: 모두가 새 게임에 대한 벤의 제안을 귀 기울여 들었다.

easy: Thanks or praise for something good you did.

ex.en: She got recognition for her hard work at the science fair.
ex.ko: 그녀는 과학 박람회에서 노력을 인정받았다.

easy: Knowing who or what something is because you have seen it before.

ex.en: The baby smiled in recognition when she saw her mom.
ex.ko: 아기는 엄마를 알아보고 미소를 지었다.

easy: People think very well of you.

ex.en: The bakery has a good reputation in town.
ex.ko: 그 빵집은 동네에서 평판이 좋다.

easy: What most people think about someone.

ex.en: Tom has a reputation for being funny.
ex.ko: 톰은 재미있는 아이라는 평판이 있다.

easy: In a quick, rude way.

ex.en: My brother answered shortly and walked away.
ex.ko: 형은 퉁명스럽게 대답하고 가 버렸다.

easy: With a lot of strength or force.

ex.en: The wind blew strongly all night.
ex.ko: 바람이 밤새 강하게 불었다.

easy: With great power.

ex.en: The swimmer pushed strongly off the wall.
ex.ko: 수영 선수는 벽을 힘차게 차고 나아갔다.

easy: A way of doing a task using special steps or skill.

ex.en: The coach showed us a new technique for throwing.
ex.ko: 코치님은 던지는 새로운 기술을 알려 주셨다.

easy: How good you are at something because you practiced a lot.

ex.en: Her piano technique got better with practice.
ex.ko: 연습할수록 그녀의 피아노 솜씨가 좋아졌다.

easy: Not thick; flat from one side to the other.

ex.en: I wrote my note on thin paper.
ex.ko: 나는 얇은 종이에 쪽지를 썼다.

easy: Not having much fat on the body.

ex.en: The thin cat could squeeze through the fence.
ex.ko: 마른 고양이는 울타리 사이로 빠져나갈 수 있었다.

easy: Very narrow.

ex.en: A thin crack ran across the cup.
ex.ko: 컵에 가느다란 금이 가 있었다.

easy: Held shut with string or rope.

ex.en: The tied box was ready to mail.
ex.ko: 끈으로 묶인 상자는 부칠 준비가 되었다.

easy: The last letter of the alphabet.

ex.en: Zoo starts with the letter Z.
ex.ko: 동물원(zoo)은 Z로 시작한다.

easy: To give reasons to show that something is right.

ex.en: Jake argued that we need a longer recess.
ex.ko: 제이크는 쉬는 시간이 더 길어야 한다고 주장했다.

easy: To talk angrily with someone who does not agree.

ex.en: My brother and I argue about who sits by the window.
ex.ko: 나와 형은 누가 창가에 앉을지를 두고 말다툼한다.

easy: A judgment about how good or valuable something is.

ex.en: The teacher's assessment of my drawing was very kind.
ex.ko: 내 그림에 대한 선생님의 평가는 매우 따뜻했다.

easy: Very unkind or unpleasant.

ex.en: He was in an awful mood and snapped at everyone.
ex.ko: 그는 기분이 아주 나빠서 모두에게 짜증을 냈다.

easy: The room where you sleep.

ex.en: My bedroom has a bunk bed and a night light.
ex.ko: 내 침실에는 이층 침대와 수면등이 있다.

easy: Something you think is true.

ex.en: Her belief that she could win made her practice harder.
ex.ko: 이길 수 있다는 믿음 덕분에 그녀는 더 열심히 연습했다.

easy: Having pages held together in a cover, like a book.

ex.en: She keeps her stories in a bound notebook.
ex.ko: 그녀는 이야기를 제본된 공책에 적어 둔다.

easy: Paying close attention so you do not make mistakes.

ex.en: I carried the full cup of milk carefully.
ex.ko: 나는 우유가 가득 든 컵을 조심스럽게 들고 갔다.

easy: Slowly and gently to stay safe.

ex.en: She walked carefully across the icy path.
ex.ko: 그녀는 얼어붙은 길을 조심조심 건넜다.

easy: The act of shutting something.

ex.en: The closing of the door woke the baby.
ex.ko: 문이 닫히는 소리에 아기가 깼다.

easy: The last part of a speech or letter.

ex.en: My letter's closing says "Love, Mina."
ex.ko: 내 편지의 맺음말은 '사랑을 담아, 미나'이다.

easy: Colors that stand for a team or school.

ex.en: Our school colors are blue and yellow.
ex.ko: 우리 학교를 상징하는 색은 파란색과 노란색이다.

easy: A round thing laid by birds and some other animals, where a baby grows.

ex.en: The bird laid a blue egg in the nest.
ex.ko: 새가 둥지에 파란 알을 낳았다.

easy: In or to some other place.

ex.en: The park was full, so we played elsewhere.
ex.ko: 공원이 꽉 차서 우리는 다른 곳에서 놀았다.

easy: More time given to finish something.

ex.en: I asked my teacher for an extension on my homework.
ex.ko: 나는 선생님께 숙제 기한을 연장해 달라고 부탁했다.

easy: Making something bigger or available to more people.

ex.en: The extension of library hours helped students.
ex.ko: 도서관 운영 시간 연장은 학생들에게 도움이 되었다.

easy: A wheel with teeth that fits with another to make parts move.

ex.en: The clock stopped when a gear broke.
ex.ko: 톱니바퀴가 부러지자 시계가 멈췄다.

easy: Parts that work together to move something, like on a bike.

ex.en: My bike has a gear that makes hills easier.
ex.ko: 내 자전거에는 언덕을 쉽게 오르게 해 주는 기어가 있다.

easy: The side of your body where your leg meets your waist.

ex.en: She put her hands on her hips and laughed.
ex.ko: 그녀는 양손을 엉덩이에 올리고 웃었다.

easy: The joint where your leg connects to your body.

ex.en: Grandma's hip hurts when she climbs stairs.
ex.ko: 할머니는 계단을 오를 때 고관절이 아프다.

easy: The act of hitting something with something else.

ex.en: Hitting a baseball takes a lot of practice.
ex.ko: 야구공을 치는 데는 많은 연습이 필요하다.

easy: Not packed tightly together.

ex.en: The garden has loose dirt that is easy to dig.
ex.ko: 정원의 흙은 푸석푸석해서 파기 쉽다.

easy: Not tight; with room to move.

ex.en: I like loose pants because they are comfy.
ex.ko: 나는 편해서 헐렁한 바지를 좋아한다.

easy: Used for attacking, not for defending.

ex.en: Our team has a strong offensive player.
ex.ko: 우리 팀에는 공격을 잘하는 선수가 있다.

easy: Rude and hurtful so that people get upset.

ex.en: Mean jokes about others are offensive.
ex.ko: 남에 대한 못된 농담은 불쾌감을 준다.

easy: Things wrapped or boxed together.

ex.en: I wrapped a package of cookies for my teacher.
ex.ko: 나는 선생님께 드릴 쿠키 꾸러미를 포장했다.

easy: A box or bag that is wrapped up to hold something.

ex.en: A package came to our door today.
ex.ko: 오늘 우리 집 문 앞에 소포가 왔다.

easy: Having a thin, sharp end.

ex.en: The gnome wore a pointed red hat.
ex.ko: 난쟁이는 뾰족한 빨간 모자를 썼다.

easy: Having very little money or very few things.

ex.en: The book is about a family that escaped poverty.
ex.ko: 그 책은 가난에서 벗어난 한 가족에 관한 이야기다.

easy: Doing a series of steps to get something ready.

ex.en: The processing of mail takes a few days.
ex.ko: 우편물 처리에는 며칠이 걸린다.

easy: Having the training and skills needed for a job.

ex.en: A qualified doctor checked my cut.
ex.ko: 자격을 갖춘 의사 선생님이 내 상처를 살펴보셨다.

easy: Officially approved to do a job.

ex.en: Only a qualified pilot can fly the plane.
ex.ko: 자격을 갖춘 조종사만 비행기를 몰 수 있다.

easy: A company that runs trains for people and goods.

ex.en: The railway added a new train to the city.
ex.ko: 철도 회사가 그 도시에 새 열차를 투입했다.

easy: The metal rails that trains run on.

ex.en: Never play on a railway track.
ex.ko: 철길에서는 절대 놀면 안 된다.

easy: Stretching out your arm to get something.

ex.en: Reaching for the top shelf, I dropped the book.
ex.ko: 맨 위 선반에 손을 뻗다가 나는 책을 떨어뜨렸다.

easy: So silly that people laugh at it.

ex.en: It is ridiculous to say that my dog can read.
ex.ko: 우리 개가 글을 읽는다는 말은 터무니없다.

easy: Very silly and funny.

ex.en: The clown's big shoes looked ridiculous.
ex.ko: 광대의 큰 신발은 우스꽝스러워 보였다.

easy: Quick to feel things like touch, light, or sound.

ex.en: My teeth are sensitive to cold ice cream.
ex.ko: 내 이는 차가운 아이스크림에 민감하다.

easy: Understanding and caring about how others feel.

ex.en: Jin is sensitive to his friend's feelings.
ex.ko: 진은 친구의 기분을 세심하게 살핀다.
